'''''327-C''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] dispatched along with [[327-A]] and [[327-B]] to attack the Rebel-allied [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility|X7 factory]] in the [[Mobetta system/Legends|Mobetta]] sector. The corvette was produced by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. It was part of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wooyou Senn]]'s [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance]].<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" />
